court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: District Judge, Vadgaon - Maval, Pune (Regular Civil Appeal No.214 of 2022)
case_name: Gaurav Balwant Lawate vs Kiran Gaurav Lawate
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in May 2017. They were blessed with a son on December 16, 2018. The respondent filed an application under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005. The petitioner filed a petition for dissolution of marriage and sought custody of the son.

legal_principles.principle: The spirit of the order passed by this Court should be kept in view.
legal_principles.held: Transfer of the proceedings was ordered with a view that it would relieve the Respondent of the hardship she otherwise would have faced in defending the Marriage Petition in the Court of Vadgaon-Maval.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to ensure that the order is complied with.
legal_principles.held: It may not be necessary to delve into the abstract question of inherent lack of jurisdiction.

outcome.final_order: The judgment and order dated November 24, 2022 was set aside, and the marriage petition was remanded to the trial court for taking action in conformity with an order passed by this Court on July 12, 2021.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
